_README: Re-shoot / generate a clip on LTX 2.5: text-to-video, or image-to-video from a first frame.
ComfyUI API-format workflow. Node category: Cinematographer.
STATUS: VERIFIED ON COMFY CLOUD 2026-11-01. This graph was executed end to end on
cloud.comfy.org (ComfyUI v0.43.2) against the real LTX 2.5 weights, with no stubs and
no missing files. The run:
status      status_str "success", completed true, node_errors {}
timing      execution_start 1793564356463 -> execution_success 1793564401280
= 44.8 s wall time; 11 nodes served from cache (the loaders and the
noise/sampler/sigma nodes), the rest executed
output      cinematographer/reshoot_ltx25_00001_.mp4, 844021 bytes
plus a native AAC audio track (236 frames) from the same pass
The two placeholders below were substituted by the app before submission, as designed:
node 1 LoadImage.image and node 9 CLIPTextEncode.text. Both are marked in the node
titles. A user loading this file by hand must substitute them too, or the run will
fail on a missing input image and generate against a placeholder prompt.
Structural validation is separate and still worth re-running yourself:
python3 workflows/validate_graphs.py
That checks the file parses as JSON, that every node has class_type + inputs, that
every class_type is in a table of slot counts read from the node sources, that
every link resolves to an existing node id and a slot that node declares, that every
node supplies a legal number of inputs for its class_type, that the graph is acyclic,
and that every node is reachable from a SaveVideo. It does NOT check that ComfyUI
accepts the prompt -- the Cloud run above is what checked that.
PROVENANCE. This is a faithful flattening of the official Lightricks two-stage graph,
fetched and read on 2026-10-29:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/master/
example_workflows/2.5/LTX-2.5_T2V_I2V_Two_Stage_Distilled.json
(191,541 bytes, matching the size the GitHub contents API reports for that path;
Apache-2.0. The sibling single-stage file, 153,776 bytes, was read for comparison.)
The upstream file is ComfyUI UI format and is built out of SIX SUBGRAPHS
(Load Models, Input Parameters, Preprocess, Sampler - Distilled (8 steps), Upscale and
re-sampler (3 steps), Decode). Subgraphs do not exist in API format, so each one was
flattened into its constituent nodes and the internal links re-pointed. Node names,
widget values and wiring below are the upstream ones, not reconstructions:
Load Models            UNETLoader, 2x VAELoader, 2x CLIPLoader, LatentUpscaleModelLoader
Input Parameters       ResizeImageMaskNode, 2x CLIPTextEncode, LTXVConditioning,
2x TextGenerateLTX2Prompt, 2x GemmaAPITextEncode, ComfySwitchNode x4,
ComfyNotNode, ComfyMathExpression, StringContains, Primitive*
Preprocess             LTXVPreprocess, EmptyLTXVLatentVideo, LTXFloatToInt,
LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, LTXVImgToVideoInplace, LTXVConcatAVLatent
Sampler (8 steps)      RandomNoise, CFGGuider, KSamplerSelect, ManualSigmas,
SamplerCustomAdvanced, LTXVSeparateAVLatent
Upscale + re-sampler   LTXVLatentUpsampler, LTXVImgToVideoInplace, LTXVConcatAVLatent,
RandomNoise, CFGGuider, KSamplerSelect, ManualSigmas,
SamplerCustomAdvanced, LTXVSeparateAVLatent
Decode                 VAEDecodeTiled, LTXVAudioVAEDecode, CreateVideo
Every class_type used here was then re-checked against the ComfyUI master source that
defines it, so the slot table in validate_graphs.py is read, not guessed:
comfy_extras/nodes_lt.py            LTXVPreprocess, EmptyLTXVLatentVideo,
LTXVImgToVideoInplace, LTXVConditioning,
LTXVConcatAVLatent, LTXVSeparateAVLatent
comfy_extras/nodes_lt_audio.py      LTXVEmptyLatentAudio, LTXVAudioVAEDecode
comfy_extras/nodes_lt_upsampler.py  LTXVLatentUpsampler
comfy_extras/nodes_hunyuan.py       LatentUpscaleModelLoader
comfy_extras/nodes_video.py         CreateVideo, SaveVideo
comfy_extras/nodes_custom_sampler.py CFGGuider, KSamplerSelect, ManualSigmas,
RandomNoise, SamplerCustomAdvanced
nodes.py                            LoadImage, ImageScale, UNETLoader, CLIPLoader,
VAELoader, CLIPTextEncode, VAEDecodeTiled
DELIBERATE DELTAS from the upstream graph, and only these:
1. The whole Input Parameters subgraph is replaced by a plain CLIPTextEncode pair.
That subgraph exists to (a) resize the input still, (b) optionally rewrite the
positive prompt with a local Gemma 4 E2B or with the LTX API, (c) derive the frame
count from fps x duration, and (d) switch conditioning between the local encode and
the API encode. (a) is done here by ImageScale, (c) is done by the app that fills
this file, and (b) and (d) are dropped on purpose -- see delta 2.
2. GemmaAPITextEncode is NOT used. It encodes and enhances the prompt through the LTX
API, i.e. a closed hosted service, and this entry's whole licence argument is that
nothing closed sits in the critical path. Dropping it also drops the
TextGenerateLTX2Prompt enhancer and its gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors weight, so
this graph needs ONE text encoder instead of two. The prompt is used as written.
3. ResizeImageMaskNode ('scale longer dimension', 1536) is replaced by ImageScale to
the exact working size. The upstream resize is a convenience for interactive use;
an API graph driven by an app knows the output size it wants, and resizing straight
to 960x544 is what the latent geometry needs anyway.
4. The ComfySwitchNode / ComfyNotNode / ComfyMathExpression / StringContains /
Primitive* plumbing is gone with the subgraph it lived in. The frame count is a
literal (121 = 1 + 15*8) instead of computed from fps x duration, because the app
computes it. The rule it must keep obeying: frames = 1 + a multiple of 8.
5. The 'use image input' toggle becomes the `bypass` widget on the two
LTXVImgToVideoInplace nodes. Both are false here, which is I2V: the still is the
first frame. Set BOTH to true for T2V. They must agree -- the upstream graph drives
them from one switch for exactly that reason.
6. The Reroute node that carried the checkpoint path into the API text encoder is
dropped with the API encoder.
7. filename_prefix -> cinematographer/*, to namespace our outputs.
8. The positive prompt is an obvious placeholder. If a generated clip ever shows
PLACEHOLDER_POSITIVE_PROMPT_INJECTION_DID_NOT_RUN, injection did not run; that is
the signal it is there for.
9. LoadImage.image is a placeholder filename. The app overwrites it with the uploaded
still on every request.
10. The upstream graph's PreviewAny node is dropped. It has an output and no consumer,
so it would be dead weight in an API export.
WHAT IS VERIFIED vs NOT:
VERIFIED      valid JSON; class_type + inputs on every node; every link resolves to
an existing node id and a declared output slot; every node supplies a
legal number of inputs; acyclic; every node reachable from SaveVideo.
NOT VERIFIED  that ComfyUI accepts this prompt; that the weights below are installed;
that it produces a clip. None of that has been run.
REQUIRED NODE PACKS (custom):
NONE. Every class_type in this graph is ComfyUI core. That is a real difference from
the LTX 2.3 graph, which needs ComfyUI-LTXVideo for its IC-LoRA nodes and
ComfyUI-CrossViewWarp for the camera. LTX 2.5's IC-LoRAs are not used here, so the
Lightricks pack is not on the critical path at all.
REQUIRED WEIGHTS (paths as ComfyUI names them; every name below is copied from the
upstream graph's own loader widgets and its 'Model Links' note, not inferred):
models/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-bf16.safetensors
models/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-bf16.safetensors
models/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
models/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
models/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors
Documented alternatives from the same note, NOT wired here:
models/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors   (convolutional decoder: lower
memory, faster, lower quality -- swap it into node 6)
models/text_encoders/gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors  (only needed by the prompt
enhancer this graph deliberately does not use)
LTX 2.5 weights are GATED on HuggingFace (Lightricks/LTX-2.5): click 'Agree and Access'
once before downloading. The text encoder is finetuned for 2.5 specifically -- it is
gemma4-12b-WITH-PROJ, i.e. the text-projection layer is baked in, which is why this
graph loads ONE CLIPLoader where the 2.3 graph loads a DualCLIPLoader plus a separate
text_projection file.
LICENCE. LTX 2.5 weights are LTX-2.x Community (revenue-capped) and gated; ComfyUI is
GPL-3.0. No MiniMax H3 and no closed API in the critical path -- the upstream graph's
optional LTX-API prompt encoder was removed for exactly that reason. See
reshoot_wan22_fun_control.json for the Apache-2.0-only alternative.
MEASURED on Comfy Cloud 2026-11-01: 44.8 s wall time for 121 frames at 1920x1088 with
native audio, on the two-stage distilled graph, with 11 nodes cached from a prior run.
That is the only timing figure in this repository taken from a real execution; it is a
Cloud measurement on Cloud hardware and will not transfer to a local card. The upstream
graph's own notes say its defaults are tuned for lower-VRAM machines and that decode
tile size is the knob to raise if you have memory; that is a quote, not our measurement.
